subject: Three-city executive demo — deconflict & final plan
messages:
From: Jason Li <jason.li@stellarnet.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive demo availability — Stellarnet / Redwood

Hi Markus / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick follow. We're ready to move our exec-level demo into the calendar — this will be a 60-minute slot (30 live demo + 30 Q&A) with our three stakeholders:
- Aiko Watanabe (APAC CEO) — prefers morning JST (09:00–11:00 JST)
- Lukas Meyer (EU Head of Engineering) — flexible afternoons CEST
- Tom Alvarez (US CTO) — prefers mornings PDT after 08:30 PDT

Our procurement timeline is tight and we'd like the exec session before the end of July if possible. Can you propose two overlapping windows that give the best chance all three execs can join live? If not possible, please propose a fallback (rotating attendance, segmented runbook, or pre-recorded segment).

I attached a short requirements sheet — initial_req.xlsx — that lists the items our CIO will want surfaced.

Best,
Jason
Stellarnet

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Jason Li <jason.li@stellarnet.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo availability — Stellarnet / Redwood

Jason — thanks for the constraints and the sheet. Short answer: we can do a single unified session that satisfies two execs live and gives partial live access to the third, or we can run a short staggered session (two quick handoffs). Two concrete, tested options below (all times shown with local equivalents):

Option A — US-first overlap (best for US + EU live)
- Proposed: Tue Jul 20, 2027 | 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 JST (next day)
- Pros: Tom (US) and Lukas (EU) can attend live.
- Cons: Aiko (APAC) would be joining at midnight JST; we recommend Aiko join for the first 20 minutes (product highlights) and then watch the recorded deep-dive.

Option B — APAC-friendly overlap (best for APAC + EU live)
- Proposed: Wed Jul 21, 2027 | 09:30 JST / 02:30 CEST / 17:30 PDT (previous day)
- Pros: Aiko and Lukas can be live for the demo portion.
- Cons: Tom would have a late afternoon US call (after hours depending on schedule).

Fallback / Hybrid (recommended if everyone needs to see everything):
- We do a single 75-minute session with clear segments (0–25 product overview, 25–55 deep-dive, 55–75 live Q&A). Execs rotate their live presence for the segment most relevant to them; we record the rest and hold a 20-minute follow-up with any exec who missed a segment.

A couple operational notes:
- Because of DST offsets (US/EU are on DST now, APAC doesn't change), the October cutover window can look different when you view by local times — strongly recommend we fix the invite in UTC in the calendar to avoid later ambiguity.
- We'll prepare a 7-minute highlighted clip that Aiko can watch before/after if she can't attend live. We can also set up a private Slack huddle for follow-ups.

Please tell us which option you prefer (A/B/hybrid) and which dates work; if you prefer another date we can shift +/- 48 hours. I'll draft a calendar invite once we lock it.

—Markus
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Jason Li <jason.li@stellarnet.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Stellarnet Scheduling <scheduling@stellarnet.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:17:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo availability — Stellarnet / Redwood

Markus / Marissa — thanks for the clear options. We discussed internally:
- Aiko can only do mornings JST (0900–1030) on those dates.
- Lukas is flexible afternoons CEST but prefers not later than 18:00 CEST.
- Tom can flex to early evenings PDT but would prefer mornings; he can make 17:30 PDT on Jul 20 if we need him to shift.

Given that, Option B (Wed Jul 21) looks closest, but 02:30 CEST is painful for Lukas. The hybrid approach may be our best bet: Aiko live for the product overview, Lukas live for the deep-dive, Tom joins for the Q&A (or the reverse depending on content).

Can you propose a packed agenda and an explicit rotation plan (who speaks when)? Also: can Redwood commit to the short highlight clip for execs who miss live segments?

I'll hold Jul 20–21 tentative — please send a firm invite this week so we can confirm with our procurement team.

Thanks,
Jason

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jason Li <jason.li@stellarnet.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo availability — Stellarnet / Redwood

Jason — putting a concrete hybrid plan on the table and a lightweight agenda so you can share with procurement. We tested these segments internally for global execs and the rotation below has worked well.

Proposed final: Tue Jul 20, 2027 | 08:00 PDT / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 JST (single session, 75 minutes)
Agenda (75 mins):
- 00:00–00:07 (7m): Welcome & exec TL;DR (Markus) — all execs encouraged to join live
- 00:07–00:32 (25m): Product walkthrough & latency/cost highlights (Aditya) — live for US/EU; recorded clip available for APAC
- 00:32–00:57 (25m): Architecture deep-dive + security/compliance (Monica) — live for EU/APAC; recording available for US exec if needed
- 00:57–01:15 (18m): Live Q&A (Marissa) — Tom (US) will join live for Q&A window; other execs can ask follow-ups via Slack/recording

Rotation notes:
- Aiko (APAC): join 00:00–00:25 for the product highlights; we will push the 7-minute highlight clip prior to the meeting so she can scan the deep-dive.
- Lukas (EU): attend live for the deep-dive segment 00:32–00:57.
- Tom (US): prioritize the Q&A block 00:57–01:15; he can dial in earlier if schedule allows.

Operational commitments from Redwood:
- Deliver the 7-minute exec highlight clip 48 hours before the session.
- Provide a time-stamped recording and an action item summary within 4 business hours after the session.
- Calendar invite will be fixed in UTC (we'll also show local equivalents in the body).

Attachments: exec-demo-agenda.pdf (attached).

If that plan looks OK, confirm and we'll send the invite + HubSpot deal update (D-20270607-SSN).

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Jason Li <jason.li@stellarnet.com>
